title: English Conversation Course
overview: The English Conversation Course is a practical, speaking-focused program designed to help adult learners communicate more confidently, naturally, and effectively in everyday, social, and workplace situations. Through guided conversations, realistic role-plays, interactive listening activities, and targeted pronunciation practice, participants strengthen fluency, expand useful vocabulary, improve conversational accuracy, and learn to sustain meaningful exchanges with different speakers. Activities are adapted to participants’ starting proficiency, with particular emphasis on active participation, clear expression, and measurable speaking progress.
audience: Adult learners with basic English knowledge who want to become more confident speakers.
Employees who interact with English-speaking colleagues, clients, or visitors.
Jobseekers preparing for interviews and professional conversations.
Individuals who want to communicate more comfortably in travel, social, and everyday settings.
Learners who understand written English but need more regular speaking and listening practice.
methodology: Training is highly interactive and communicative, using paired and small-group discussions, structured speaking drills, scenario-based role-plays, short authentic listening clips, pronunciation coaching, information-gap tasks, guided debates, and mini-presentations. The trainer provides immediate, constructive feedback on clarity, fluency, vocabulary, pronunciation, and interaction strategies. An initial speaking diagnostic and end-of-course performance task support individualized improvement.
competencies: Conversational fluency and confidence in familiar social and professional situations.
Active listening and appropriate turn-taking in two-way communication.
Functional vocabulary and expressions for common conversational purposes.
Clear pronunciation, stress, rhythm, and intonation for intelligible speech.
Question formation, follow-up questioning, and conversational development.
Appropriate use of polite language, register, and cross-cultural communication conventions.
Ability to clarify meaning, paraphrase, and repair communication breakdowns.
Self-monitoring and continued independent speaking practice.
objectivesIntro: By the end of this course, participants will be able to:
objectives: Introduce themselves, exchange personal and professional information, and sustain short conversations.
Initiate, maintain, and close conversations using natural expressions and appropriate etiquette.
Ask clear questions, respond with relevant details, and use follow-up questions to extend discussions.
Understand the main points of common spoken exchanges and respond appropriately.
Describe experiences, routines, plans, preferences, and opinions with improved fluency.
Participate in everyday workplace conversations, requests, meetings, and telephone interactions.
Use clearer pronunciation, word stress, and intonation to improve listener understanding.
Manage misunderstandings through clarification, repetition, and paraphrasing.
Demonstrate improved speaking confidence in realistic role-play and conversation assessments.
